description: This is a React component source file for a Next.js frontend application that manages persona creation and editing, including file uploads, draft generation, version control, and user interactions.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts input to an array of strings.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Transforms backend JSON data into persona data format used by the component.

methods.name: handleFileChange
methods.description: Handles file selection or drop events, updating the file list.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds new files to the current file list.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles files dropped into the upload zone.

methods.name: handleDragOver
methods.description: Prevents default behavior during drag-over events.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a file from the current upload list.

methods.name: handleGenerateDraft
methods.description: Triggers draft generation for the persona.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Saves current persona edits as a new version.

methods.name: handleFinalize
methods.description: Finalizes the persona, marking it as complete.

methods.name: removeSkill
methods.description: Removes a skill from the persona.

methods.name: addSkill
methods.description: Adds a new skill to the persona.

methods.name: handleProfileImageChange
methods.description: Updates the profile image of the persona.
